description: Run a customer-authored Jython- or JavaScript-style transform script per record or per batch against an upstream DataFrame.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset providing the input DataFrame

language.label: Language
language.description: jython: real CPython in a subprocess, with a Java-collection emulation shim and Jython-style integer division. javascript: QuickJS (quickjs-ng) -- no filesystem/network/process access by construction. Groovy is not supported.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: record: script runs once per row, sees `record`. batch: script runs once, sees `records` (a list of all rows this materialization is processing).

init_script.label: Init Script
init_script.description: Runs once before the first record/batch.

destroy_script.label: Destroy Script
destroy_script.description: Runs once after the last record/batch.

user_params.label: User Params
user_params.description: Exposed to the script as `userParams` (a dict/JMap).

state_path.label: State Path
state_path.description: Where `state` is persisted across RUNS as JSON (same pattern as s3_monitor's dynamic-partition pruning state). Unset: state starts empty every run and isn't persisted.

on_script_error.label: On Script Error
on_script_error.description: record_error: a script exception is caught per record (mode: record) or for the whole batch (mode: batch) and recorded in this asset's metadata; the run continues. fail: the exception propagates and fails the run.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Hard wall-clock timeout for the WHOLE materialization's script execution (not per record) -- the subprocess is terminated if it doesn't finish in time.

javascript_memory_limit_mb.label: Javascript Memory Limit Mb
javascript_memory_limit_mb.description: QuickJS heap limit in MB (javascript mode only) -- a real, enforced backstop, not documentation-only.

name: Script Evaluator
